findings.message: Candidate wall 'wall-storey-1-storey-1-wall-notch-west' world bounding box y spans 5.2-12.6 m, but the confirmed Design Brief fact (/known_facts/walls/3, notch_west start [4700,4700] end [4700,12100]) requires y 4.7-12.1 m. The ObjectPlacement origin [4700, 8900, 0] with profile y=7400 centers the wall at y=8.9 m instead of the required center y=8.4 m, a +0.5 m northward shift. The deterministic geometry gate is authoritative and has failed; this is a true candidate geometry error, not a gate dispute.

Candidate wall 'wall-storey-2-storey-2-wall-notch-west' world bounding box y spans 5.2-12.6 m at z 3.15-6.15 m, but the confirmed fact (/known_facts/walls/13) requires y 4.7-12.1 m. Same +0.5 m northward misplacement as the storey-1 notch-west wall.

Candidate wall 'wall-storey-3-storey-3-wall-notch-west' world bounding box y spans 5.2-12.6 m at z 6.3-9.3 m, but the confirmed fact (/known_facts/walls/23) requires y 4.7-12.1 m. Same +0.5 m northward misplacement repeated on the third storey.

Deterministic geometry gate reports the expected wall geometry does not form the required room enclosure (/walls). This is a downstream consequence of the mislocated notch-west walls: because these C-notch west walls are shifted +0.5 m in Y, the notch boundary does not close against the notch-south/notch-north walls at y=4.8 m and y=12.0 m, leaving the circulation/classroom enclosure open.

The geometry expectation engine could not derive required slab geometry (reason floor_slab_geometry_missing) for /known_facts/floor_slabs/0, /1 and /2, so expectation_complete=false and unresolved_expectation_count=3. Slab and roof geometry therefore remain unverified by the deterministic geometry gate and must not be assumed compliant. This is an expectation-coverage limitation reported alongside the failed gate, not a candidate defect by itself.

Machine-readable artifacts contradict each other. repair/route.json reports route 'no_repair_needed' with geometry_issue_count 0 and metrics.repair.geometry_issue_count 0, while deterministic geometry_feedback reports three WALL_SEGMENT_MISMATCH issues and geometry_success=false with gate_summary_passed=false. The deterministic geometry gate is authoritative, so no repair route may waive the failure. This discrepancy is flagged for human/developer review and still blocks acceptance.

Confirmed user requirements are otherwise reflected in the candidate: east-opening C outline with no notch cover (roof-slab and all three storey slabs use the continuous-C polygon with no slab over x 4.8-13.2 / y 4.8-12.0), three identical storey outlines, 200 mm brick walls spanning the C's eight edge segments plus two partition walls in the x 4.6-4.8 m band, nine spaces (south classroom x 4.8-13.0 / y 0.2-4.6, north classroom x 4.8-13.0 / y 12.2-16.6, circulation x 0.2-4.6 / y 0.2-16.6) matching the reported space bboxes, two parallel straight flights (x 0.4-1.6 and x 2.8-4.0, y 5.4-10.8, 18x175 risers, 300 tread) with slab openings only on storey-2 and storey-3, seven windows per storey at the required centers with 900 mm sills, classroom doors at y 2.4/14.4, the single storey-1 entrance door corrected to y 4.2 m per turn-user-003, and no east-end windows. These are noted for user-requirement compliance but do not offset the failed deterministic geometry gate.
